mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_question q WHERE q.category_id = #{categoryId} AND q.delete_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE q.category_id = #{categoryId} AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND a.delete_flag = 0

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, COALESCE(qc.cnt, 0) AS questionCount FROM qa_category c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM qa_question q JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) ) qc ON qc.rootId = c.id WHERE c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT root.id, root.name, root.icon, COALESCE(qc.cnt, 0) AS questionCount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(leaf.parent_id, leaf.id) AS rootId, SUM(ri.score) AS score, MAX(ri.updated_at) AS lastTime FROM rec_user_interest ri JOIN qa_category leaf ON leaf.id = ri.category_id WHERE ri.user_id = #{userId} AND ri.score > 0 AND leaf.delete_flag = 0 AND leaf.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(leaf.parent_id, leaf.id) ) pref JOIN qa_category root ON root.id = pref.rootId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM qa_question q JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) ) qc ON qc.rootId = root.id WHERE root.delete_flag = 0 AND root.status = 1 AND root.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY pref.score DESC, pref.lastTime DESC, root.sort ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT root.id, root.name, root.icon, COALESCE(qc.cnt, 0) AS questionCount FROM qa_category root JOIN ( SELECT pref.rootId, SUM(pref.score) AS score, MAX(pref.lastTime) AS lastTime FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 1.0 AS score, MAX(h.created_at) AS lastTime FROM user_browse_history h JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = h.biz_id JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.biz_type = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 3.0 AS score, MAX(v.created_at) AS lastTime FROM qa_vote v JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = v.biz_id JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 1 AND v.vote_type = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 4.0 AS score, MAX(f.created_at) AS lastTime FROM qa_favorite f JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = f.question_id JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) ) pref GROUP BY pref.rootId ) pref ON pref.rootId = root.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM qa_question q JOIN qa_category cat ON cat.id = q.category_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND cat.delete_flag = 0 AND cat.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.id) ) qc ON qc.rootId = root.id WHERE root.delete_flag = 0 AND root.status = 1 AND root.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY pref.score DESC, pref.lastTime DESC, root.sort ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
